symptom: Telemetry helpers represented 0/0 cases as 100%, which could falsely imply proven success for unexercised resume or correlation behavior.
root_cause: Convenience handling for empty denominators conflated absence of failures with demonstrated effectiveness.
early_signals: No formal Human Task was created during the observed interruption
Correlation Integrity therefore had no empirical denominator
human_cost: No operator troubleshooting; risk was semantic overstatement in the final receipt.
prevention_rule: Metrics with zero empirical denominator must report NOT_APPLICABLE/null rather than 100%, unless the metric definition explicitly treats zero activity as successful by design.
automated_detection: MOCATRIZ telemetry exposes applicability flags and returns null for zero-denominator recovery/resume/correlation ratios.
